metadata.name: Template Translate Provider
metadata.author: Your Name
metadata.description: Template plugin demonstrating lyrics line-by-line translation.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.subtitle: Your service API key, stored securely in the system Keyring

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.subtitle: 0.0 for deterministic output, up to 2.0 for higher variation

maxOutputTokens.title: Max Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.subtitle: Maximum tokens returned per chunk request

useSongContext.title: Send song info as context
useSongContext.subtitle: Sends song title and artist to help determine subject pronouns and tone

customInstruction.title: Custom Instruction
customInstruction.subtitle: Extra rules appended to the prompt, e.g. 'Use poetic Vietnamese rhymes'
customInstruction.placeholder: e.g. Keep English slang terms untouched

systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.subtitle: Full system instruction. Variables: {target_language}, {custom_instruction}
systemPrompt.default:
You translate song lyrics into {target_language}.

Rules:
- Return a JSON object with a single key 'lines': a list of {'i': number, 't': text, 'l': detected_language}.
- Return exactly one item per input line, preserving original 'i' order.
- Lines already in {target_language} or sound effects (la la, oh oh) should remain unchanged.
- Maintain song emotion, rhythm and voice consistency.

{custom_instruction}
